legalCitations.description: Perjury statute — false sworn statement in official proceedings is perjury under Illinois criminal code
Allows certification under penalty of perjury as alternative to sworn affidavits - has same force and effect (future enhancement)
Governs use of affidavits in civil procedure
Illinois Oaths and Affirmations Act - 'Subscribed and sworn to before me' jurat language requirement
Illinois Notary Public Act - governs notarization requirements and jurat formats

affidavitJurat:
Signed and sworn (or affirmed) to before me on _____________ (date)
by __________________ (name of person making statement).


_________________________________
Notary Public

[Notary Seal]

My commission expires: ___________

exhibitRules.instructions: Exhibits may be labeled with letters (A, B, C, etc.) or numbers. Cover pages are recommended but not required.
